'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Justin Montgomery LS Kashyyyk (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Montgomery]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kashyyyk (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
